summary: MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED: the update adds an optional Pre-Vote round (new pre-candidate state, Pre-Vote request/response messages, a new elect() caller, a changed timer election path, and changed do_elect/become_following effects). The reference base/MC/Trace suite was updated, Update.tla with full/focused/open/discharge and scenario configs was generated, and the prior engine-level harness was rebased (context drift only) and extended with 10 update scenarios. 17 fresh traces pass real TLC trace validation with TraceConsumed, and 12/12 single-field mutation controls are rejected. Two prior-model defects found during validation were repaired: empty-log comparison, which had made the prior 3-node MC unable to elect any leader, and the missing leader lease on establishment. Bounded model checking (budget-limited BFS plus simulation, LIMITED_COVERAGE) found three update-introduced defects. All three were reproduced on the updated implementation through the public Raft API with RPC hooks; release builds behave the same, and a control repair makes the tests pass. MC-1 (High): a Pre-Vote round started by the election timer while the node is a Candidate survives establish_leader, and its quorum makes the new leader re-elect at term+1. This trips the try_leader_handler debug assertion; in release builds the leader abandons leadership and the term inflates. MC-2 (Medium): a completed Pre-Vote round calls elect() for a node that has left the voters, and its self-grant panics RaftCore in Candidate::grant_by. MC-3 (Medium): a repeated round at the same hypothetical vote counts a delayed grant from a removed node, panicking RaftCore. specular ci-result verdict: FAIL.
